content.title: IPL 2026 Points Table: Updated Team Rankings And Net Run Rate After RR Steamroll CSK
content.text: Rajasthan Royals began their IPL 2026 with a convincing win over Chennai Super Kings on Monday (March 30). Here's what the points table looks like after that result. Rajasthan Royals thrash Chennai Super Kings at Guwahati RR skipper Riyan Parag won the toss and chose to field first. His bowlers vindicated the call with an excellent Powerplay as Jofra Archer, Nandre Burger and Sandeep Sharma removed CSK's entire top four to leave them 38-4. Sarfaraz Khan, Shivam Dube and Kartik Sharma were all also back in the hut within 11 overs, and it was eventually left to Jamie Overton to score 43 and drag them to 127, following a 33-run last-wicket stand with Anshul Kamboj. The target was unlikely to ever trouble Rajasthan. 18 runs came off the first over as Vaibhav Sooryavanshi hit Matt Henry for six and four. The onslaught didn't stop there, as the 15-year-old took on every single bowler, getting to a half-century off 15 balls with consecutive sixes off Noor Ahmad. He holed out for 52 off Anshul Kamboj, but by then the chase was a formality. Yashasvi Jaiswal and Riyan Parag took RR over the line for an eight-wicket win with 47 balls to spare. IPL 2026: Updated points table after RR vs CSK The IPL's inaugural champions are now on top of the table. CSK are sixth, with four teams yet to kick off their campaigns.
